metaDescription: Turkish Angora vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Turkish Angora boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Turkish Angora owners tracking 12-18 years lifespans still lose the mid-series booster more often than the first shot, and the unprotected gap after week 8 is where panleukopenia risk concentrates for this kitten.
Use the 4-row Turkish Angora schedule as your only planning spine: 8 weeks (FVRCP); 12 weeks (FVRCP booster); 16 weeks (FVRCP booster); 16 weeks (Rabies).

Temperament note for Turkish Angora handling: Elegant; deafness risk in white cats is classic.. Schedule quieter appointment slots if that profile makes clinic visits harder, but do not skip the Turkish Angora dose.
Lifestyle add-ons stay off this Turkish Angora core list until your veterinarian maps exposure, so keep core dates sacred either way.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: If your Turkish Angora misses the dose scheduled near week 12, call the clinic the same day with product names — do not restart the Turkish Angora series from memory.
The danger for a delayed Turkish Angora is the gap, not the embarrassment, because panleukopenia pressure stays real for an under-vaccinated kitten even in clean-looking neighborhoods.
While waiting for the make-up FVRCP visit, skip high-traffic dog parks / unknown-cat intros and keep the Turkish Angora away from unvaccinated animals.
After catch-up, rewrite reminders for the next Turkish Angora due date (7, 3, and 1 day prior) so the same miss does not recur.

faqs.question: When does the Turkish Angora core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual kitten.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Turkish Angora misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Turkish Angora health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Turkish Angora adult health guide for breed predispositions such as deafness risk (especially white/blue-eyed), then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
